lanes.title: Make the legacy admission scope lock fail fast (FOR SHARE NOWAIT) instead of waiting
lanes.description:
Coordinator decision recorded as a comment on OVD-598 (2026-10-05 16:35Z); it amends the acceptance criteria (R1 reworded, R4/R5 added, client error mapping added) and is authoritative together with the issue. Change, all inside PR #580 (existing branch, existing draft PR, head 9c18f46):
1. Migration 20261004100000_ovd598_serialize_legacy_xometry_admission.sql: in private.lock_xometry_beta_dispatch_scope_rows, every row lock becomes FOR SHARE NOWAIT (same rows, same order, same strength). Wrap the locking statements so that SQLSTATE 55P03 (lock_not_available) is re-raised as `raise exception using errcode="P0001", message="xometry_beta_job_busy"` (match the message/hint convention of the other named denials in that migration, e.g. xometry_beta_trusted_step_required). Everything else in the migration byte-identical; the request body remains byte-for-byte 20261002182910 plus the one helper call; revoke/grant restated unchanged. The migration number/timestamp does not change (it is still unapplied anywhere); do NOT add a new migration.
2. supabase/tests/xometry_beta_dispatch_admission_serialization.sql: rewrite R1 per the amended criterion (request fails immediately with xometry_beta_job_busy while the editor transaction is open; assert there is NO Lock waiter for the request; zero rows; then a fresh request after the editor commits fails with the field denial); keep R2 and R3; add R4 (worker api_register_trusted_file_hash interleaving: no 40P01 either side) and R5 (api_reset_client_part_property_overrides interleaving: no 40P01 either side, client edit never the victim). Keep real Lock-waiter assertions (pg_stat_activity, pg_blocking_pids) where a wait is expected; never timing assumptions. Update plan(N).
3. src/features/quotes/xometry-admission-lock-migration.test.ts: pin NOWAIT on every scope lock and the 55P03 -> xometry_beta_job_busy mapping, plus the unchanged byte-for-byte request body.
4. Client mapping: one line mapping the RPC error `xometry_beta_job_busy` to a retry message in the existing quotes error-mapping helper (find where xometry_beta_* denials are mapped for the quote request flow; follow that pattern) with a unit test.
5. PR body: remove the Linear closing words ("Fix: OVD-628", "Fix: OVD-629"; refer to them as hardening follow-ups for the generic path, plain mentions only), replace the deadlock section with the new design (why NOWAIT makes the request cycle-free: it waits only on advisory locks taken before any row lock), record the reproduced cycles from the reviews as the failure-first evidence, keep every other section truthful at the new head.
6. OVD-598 Linear issue description: apply the amended criteria text from the coordinator comment to the Acceptance criteria section (patch op), and update the rolling comment.
lanes.guidance: Existing branch and draft PR #580 (never rebase/amend/force-push; add commits). Lockfile family #564 (/home/user/wt/base564 symlinks). Run ensure-docker.sh and `supabase status` first; DB work under /tmp/ovd-supabase.lock; keep locked sections short. The free-quote CI profile pin (137) does not change because the migration file keeps its name; but the closed profile pins the migration CONTENT hash: re-pin per the #574/#580 pattern (scripts/fixtures/free-quote-ci-source.json etc.) and run node --test scripts/free-quote-ci-profile.node-test.mjs, node scripts/generate-free-quote-fixtures.mjs --check, npm run verify:migration-lineage. Sonar: grouped dispositions in the body stay; refresh line numbers. After pushing, merge-forward into the stacked branch claude/server-empty-file-upload-rejection (#592) with a merge commit and push it too (its profile re-pin 138 must still pass its node tests; fix the content pin there if the test fails). Never write the release-parent identifiers listed in ENV.md.
lanes.failure_first: Record red first at 9c18f46 (before the change): (a) the worker trusted-hash interleaving from the review -> 40P01 on one side; (b) the api_reset_client_part_property_overrides interleaving from OVD-629 -> 40P01 (client edit victim). Record the exact excerpts. After the change: the same two interleavings produce no 40P01 on either side (R4, R5 green), and the R1 variant shows the immediate xometry_beta_job_busy with no Lock waiter. Mutation on a scratch copy only: remove NOWAIT from one lock -> R4 or R5 reproduces the 40P01 again.
lanes.verification: flock /tmp/ovd-supabase.lock sh -c "supabase db reset --local && supabase test db --local supabase/tests/xometry_beta_dispatch_admission_serialization.sql"; then the full supabase test db --local under the lock (capability_runtime_persistence_concurrency.sql is a known environment-only failure); npx vitest run src/features/quotes/xometry-admission-lock-migration.test.ts and the error-mapping test; node --test scripts/free-quote-ci-profile.node-test.mjs; node scripts/generate-free-quote-fixtures.mjs --check; npm run verify:migration-lineage; npm run lint && npm run typecheck; flock /tmp/ovd-verify.lock npm run verify at the PR boundary. Hosted (authoritative): free-quote-sql, test, ovd591 jobs, Sonar at the new head.
